answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil attacks are resisted by mandating that every new agent bind a unique computational kernel to a non-fungible stake of scarce physical-equivalent resources, similar to the extraction cost of shale. This kernel is then cross-verified by a multi-party prism of peer attestations that cryptographically confirm the resource commitment, forcing any attacker to replicate both the scarce stake and the verification overhead for each fake identity, thereby making mass identity fabrication economically prohibitive.
